stories.title: Mbappé sorry for 'ill-judged' Mao remark after backlash in China
stories.brief: The France star had referred to the former Chinese leader as a "dictator" during an interview about memes.

stories.title: Chinese markets lose trillions as race for AI supremacy with US takes its toll
stories.brief: Other indexes of major companies dropped by about 20% over the same time period.

stories.title: Karachi suspect accused of luring women for jobs, stealing their phones beaten with slippers during court appearance
stories.brief: The suspect was arrested by the police on Monday for his alleged involvement in stealing the mobile phones of 59 women, who were brought to the farmhouse in October under the pretext of a job interview.

stories.title: ATC reserves verdict in security breach case against Imaan, Hadi
stories.brief: ISLAMABAD: The trial of human rights lawyer Imaan Zainab Mazari-Hazir and her husband, Hadi Ali Chattha, in the security breach case concluded at Adiala Jail on Tuesday, with the anti-terrorism court (ATC) reserving its verdict.

stories.title: Army destroys Afghan border check posts after 5 of a family injured, one killed in Angoor Adda: official
stories.brief: The Pakistan Army on Tuesday night destroyed Afghan Taliban check posts after they targeted civilian areas in South Waziristan's Angoor Adda along the border, injuring five members of a family and killing one member.

stories.title: Pakistan’s child protection system failing to address online sexual abuse: HRCP
stories.brief: The Human Rights Commission of Pakistan (HRCP) warned on Tuesday that online sexual abuse of children remained a serious child protection concern, with underreporting, weak institutional coordination and inadequate safeguards preventing many cases from coming to light.

stories.title: Naqvi hints at Imran's transfer to Islamabad’s new Model Jail
stories.brief: Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi hinted on Tuesday that incarcerated PTI founder Imran Khan could be shifted to a new jail in Islamabad. He said he had inspected the jail's kitchen and hospital during the visit, adding that prisoners currently held in Islamabad would be shifted to the new facility after inauguration by the premier.

stories.title: Bilawal floats end to further debate on administrative units in Sindh
stories.brief: Pakistan Peoples Party (PPP) Chairman Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari on Tuesday said the Sindh Assembly had already made its decision on the issue of further administrative units in the province and the debate should now be put to rest.

stories.title: ATC reserves verdict in barrier removal case against Imaan, Hadi
stories.brief: The Islamabad ATC framed charges against Imaan and Hadi on October 7 in the barrier removal case. On Monday, Imaan and Hadi approached the Supreme Court against an Islamabad High Court (IHC) decision concerning their request to halt trial proceedings in an anti-terrorism case.

stories.title: Govt, JI form committee to expand fuel relief scheme, phase out petroleum levy
stories.brief: The government and Jamaat-e-Islami (JI) on Tuesday agreed to form a six-member committee to finalise recommendations on expanding the existing petrol relief scheme and preparing proposals for a phased reduction in the petroleum levy.

stories.title: Man held for ‘robbing 59 women of mobile phones’ in Gadap farmhouse
stories.brief: KARACHI: Police on Monday claimed to have arrested the prime suspect allegedly involved in stealing the mobile phones of 59 women, who were brought to a farmhouse in Gadap on Oct 1 on the pretext of job interviews.

stories.title: I get £4,062 a year and am trying my best - here's what I want from the Budget
stories.brief: People on a range of incomes from £4,062 to £150,000 a year tell the BBC what they want to see in this year's Budget.

stories.title: 'An annoying buzz': The search for stealthier drones
stories.brief: As drone deliveries become more commonplace, their makers are looking for ways to make them quieter.

stories.title: Will a new strategy help protect Northern Ireland's nature?
stories.brief: About 40% of the plants and animals in protected sites across Northern Ireland fall short of meeting the standard for "favourable condition".

stories.title: Nanotyrannus skeleton sells for $47.3m in New York auction
stories.brief: The sale of the rare skeleton reignites debate in the scientific community about whether dinosaur remains should end up in private hands or public view.

stories.title: Scotland's recycling rates at five-year low. How is your area doing?
stories.brief: Environmental regulator Sepa says households recycled 42.8% of waste in 2025 - down from 44.3% the previous year.

stories.title: How Kane defied doubters to become world's best
stories.brief: Harry Kane is the humble 'anti-superstar' who defied doubters to achieve Ballon d'Or greatness, says chief football writer Phil McNulty.

stories.title: What is Nasa's Artemis III mission? And what comes next?
stories.brief: Artemis III will help test crucial systems needed for the planned Artemis IV Moon landing in 2028.

stories.title: Apple to replace iPhone Duos affected by screen problem
stories.brief: Photos shared online showed faults appearing on the screens of Apple's first foldable device.

stories.title: 'I would do it again' - Kaepernick reflects on price of protest, 10 years on
stories.brief: In his first interview with BBC Sport since taking the knee for the first time, Colin Kaepernick reflects on his journey.
